svg.title: Swaralaya
svg.desc: Swaralaya. A practice studio for Indian classical music: real-time pitch shifting in the browser, a C++ service, and Demucs splitting songs into six stems. Built with C++, Python, Next.js, Web Audio.
svg.text: A practice studio for Indian classical music: real-

and Demucs splitting songs into six stems.
